text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali to hold two-day meeting with Spanish counterpart Jose Maria Aznar on June 4-5.
- Local council polls due on June 13 will be a new step to reinforce regionalisation and democracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri meets French businessmen.
- Three people drown off a Casablanca beach.
- Belgium Interior Minister Johan Van Lanotte expected in Morocco mid-June.
- Candidates' dull campaign for local council elections show old habits die hard.
- Staff at farmers' credit bank Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole (CNCA) stick to two-day strike despite talks with the management.
- Head of African Development Bank (ADB) warns that bank might have to close if attempts to restructure its capital fail.
